gorillaUpdate.notes: [required] Ready for the 28 October game update: Gorilla knows its 62 new moves and 11 new wrestlers. Custom moves gone after TRIBUTE's update? Fix my game now tells you, and dropping your Gorilla move packs again brings them back on their own numbers. New: finishers with their own start action (Pop Off), moves from other animation banks keep their own sounds, whole BakeMe restore points on Go back.
